#### Support Windows .zip artifacts in release manifest and publish

Discover <tool>_<version>_<os>_<arch>.zip archives (windows) alongside
.tar.gz (darwin/linux), include windows in the default OS set, and upload
each archive with the correct content type (application/zip vs
application/gzip).
